warnings: CDLI is modeled as one evolving modern scholarly digital-resource Work, not as its changing organization, one immutable database release, the physical artifacts it describes, or a collection of ancient Works.
Current coverage, site, collection, and update figures are dated live observations and are not treated as invariants or completeness guarantees.

Artifact identity, provenience, place of writing, current custody, excavation, findspot, archive, composite, publication, representation, language, genre, material, and uncertainty remain separate future relations.

The official terms are layer-specific; public access, APIs, linked data, software licences, and academic text reuse do not create a blanket licence over metadata, museum images, line art, inscriptions, publications, derivatives, model training, or redistribution.
Fresh 2026 evidence shows that CDLI metadata can be source-dependent, manually produced, scripted, and LLM-assisted; database presence and schema validity therefore do not prove field correctness.
The exact current bulk release, timestamp, checksum, field scope, and rights remain unresolved; the 2022.01 Zenodo deposit is not treated as a current release.
The July 2026 point-cloud paper is retained only as a deferred preprint challenger, not artifact, provenance, dating, genre, reading, or rights authority.
